title: Ocean's 11
description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve.

title: Mickey 17
description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

title: All Eyez on Me
description: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices.

title: Megan Leavey
description: Young Marine Cpl. Megan Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive combat dog that she trains. Together, they complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

title: Ocean's Eight
description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger.

title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
description: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman join forces with their American counterparts to battle a ruthless and common enemy.

title: Companion
description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

title: Working Girls
description: A photographer (Louise Smith) and others work for a yuppie madam (Ellen McElduff) in a Manhattan brothel, then go home.

title: The Watchers
description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night.

title: Holla
description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness.

title: I Love You Forever
description: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship.

title: Hop
description: Reluctant to take over his father's job, the son (Russell Brand) of the Easter Bunny runs away to Los Angeles, where he tricks an unemployed slacker (James Marsden) into taking care of him.

title: Christmas With the Kranks
description: A Chicago couple scramble to put together a holiday celebration after their daughter decides to come home for Christmas.

title: Grudge Match
description: A boxing promoter (Kevin Hart) offers two rival boxers (Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone) the chance to come out of retirement for one final bout.

title: My Blind Brother
description: An overachieving, blind athlete (Adam Scott) and his slacker sibling (Nick Kroll) compete for the affection of the same woman (Jenny Slate).

title: Judy
description: Beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform at the Talk of the Town nightclub in 1968. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband.

title: The East
description: Hired to infiltrate a group of ecoterrorists, an undercover operative (Brit Marling) instead finds herself growing sympathetic to the cause and attracted to the leader (Alexander Skarsgård).

title: Friendship
description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor.

title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
description: An ancient Celtic ritual drives Dr. Loomis' (Donald Pleasence) patient to sacrifice an entire family in Haddonfield, Ill.

title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
description: In hiding for two decades, a traumatized woman (Jamie Lee Curtis) learns her murderous brother has returned for her.

title: Halloween: Resurrection
description: Internet users watch six collegians as they spend the night in Michael Myers' (Brad Loree) childhood home.

title: A Clockwork Orange
description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society.

title: The Apparition
description: A paranormal researcher (Tom Felton) must save a couple (Ashley Greene, Sebastian Stan) from a malevolent entity that feeds on fear and torments them no matter where they run.

title: Patti Cake$
description: Patricia, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back.

title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves.

title: Odd Jobs
description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business.

title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
description: Ten-year-old Gloria and her grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home.

title: The Greatest Showman
description: P.T. Barnum indulges his limitless imagination to create the Barnum & Bailey circus in the 1800s. Featuring musical numbers, exotic performers and daring feats, the mesmerizing spectacle takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

title: Blood Simple
description: Complications arise when the owner of a Texas bar pays a man (M. Emmet Walsh) to kill his wife (Frances McDormand) and her lover (John Getz).

title: Mississippi Masala
description: People resent the romance of a black man (Denzel Washington) and an Indian woman (Sarita Choudhury) in a Mississippi town.

title: Spring Breakers
description: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work.

title: Pitch Perfect 3
description: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait.

title: Green Zone
description: An Army officer and his team of inspectors stumble upon an elaborate cover-up as they hunt for weapons of mass destruction in Iraq.

title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home.

title: Happy Death Day
description: A college student must relive the day of her murder over and over again, in a loop that will end only when she discovers her killer's identity.

title: Extraction
description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative.

title: This Is Not a War Story
description: Some veterans take part in an unusual art project designed to help them deal with the leftover trauma associated with their combat experiences.

title: Buffaloed
description: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector.

title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era.

title: The Whistlers
description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

title: Walk the Line
description: Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) forms an enduring bond with June Carter (Reese Witherspoon) and struggles with drug addiction on the way to music stardom.

title: Trance
description: A criminal (Vincent Cassel) hires a hypnotherapist (Rosario Dawson) to probe the mind of a brain-injured auctioneer (James McAvoy) to uncover the hiding place of a stolen painting.

title: Opus
description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan.

title: Aniara
description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

title: Joker
description: Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, failed comedian Arthur Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Joker: Folie à Deux
description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.
